subject: Halcyon Retail: Success Map, Data Handoff & Sprint 0 Checklist
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@halcyonretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Halcyon Retail: Success Map, Data Handoff & Sprint 0 Checklist

Hi Samir — thanks again for a focused call today. Quick recap and proposed plan to keep the POC moving: 

1) Success criteria (mutually agreed):
- Precision/Recall target for receipt parsing: P >= 92% and R >= 88% on Holdout set
- End-to-end inference latency <= 300ms p95 on 2KB payloads
- Basic integration: Redwood embeddings + similarity search on their product catalog for 3 demo scenarios

2) Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Sprint 0 (this week): data handoff, permission check, sample dataset validation (owner: Halcyon / Samir) — target: Tue 2027-05-04
- Week 1: run baseline runs, validate metrics on Redwood hosted test harness (owner: Marissa) — target: 2027-05-10
- Week 2: iterate on prompt templates, quantization profile and cost estimates (owner: Rafael + Monica)

3) Ownership & next steps (actionable):
- Samir: confirm S3 read-only credentials for the sample bucket or share a 1GB sample export by Tue 5/4
- Procurement (procurement@halcyonretail.com): we will need a signed POC MSA or a PO for compute allocation — draft attached for reference
- Marissa Cole (CS): lead Redwood runbook + daily check-in during Week 1
- Rafael Mendes (Infra): prepare ephemeral capacity and test endpoint config; share access instructions
- Monica (AE): coordinate status and executive checkpoints, provide cost/run rate estimates after Week 1

Attachments: poc-checklist.xlsx (POC checklist and acceptance matrix), halcyon-data-spec.md (sample schema).

Proposed kickoff: Wed 2027-05-05 10:00 PT (I put a tentative calendar hold — see link below). If that time doesn't work, propose alternatives.

Thanks — I want to keep this lightweight but with clear owners so we don't drift.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Related links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=kickoff-halcyon ; https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AxyzHALCYON

- Procurement: I'll loop procurement on the POC MSA — we usually need a short SOW + PO for anything over $5k. Procurement, can you confirm internal timeline?

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Halcyon POC support (owners & quick asks)

Internal note — please treat this as internal coordination. Short asks before the kickoff: 

- Marissa: can you prepare the baseline runbook (one-pager) that includes the test harness steps, expected metrics and the location of the scoring notebook? I'll use it in the kickoff. Target: EOD Tue 5/4.
- Rafael: confirm which model variant and quantization profiles we should expose for initial runs (we discussed a 4-bit int8-ish baseline). Also prepare a short note on expected cost per 1k requests so we can put numbers in the SOW.
- I'll own executive status and keep Samir looped.

One-line: if we don't get sample data by Tue morning, we shift the baseline to 5/11 and update the calendar.

Thanks — M.

Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Halcyon POC kickoff — calendar confirmation + open items (gentle nudge)

Hi Samir / Procurement team —

Quick check-in ahead of the Wed kickoff: calendar hold is still on for 2027-05-05 10:00 PT. A few open items to confirm before we start: 

- S3 access: Samir, did your infra team share the ARN / role? If not, please confirm ETA.
- PO / SOW: Procurement, can you share the PO number or confirm who will sign the attached HAL-Statement-of-Work-draft.docx? We can run the engagement under the draft SOW for initial runs if procurement needs extra time, but we need a PO to provision Dedicated capacity beyond free credit.
- Technical contacts: please confirm the names and Slack handles of the two engineers who will join the kickoff.

If we have the S3 link and a PO by EOD Tue, we can proceed with the original timeline. Otherwise, we'll reschedule to allow for the dataset to be uploaded.

Attachments: HAL-Statement-of-Work-draft.docx

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142
